LanguageData.MiliraXian_BackStoryChild_Qinghe_BS1.des: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up among many kinds of flowers. Among the six branches born from "Ji", her resonance with "life" was the deepest. From the first time she heard the flowers' words, they became part of her life.\n\n"The flower message may not arrive at once, but someone must first clear the water's surface."
LanguageData.MiliraXian_BackStoryAdult_Qinghe_BS1.des: After leaving the Flower God's Court in the distant immortal realm, [PAWN_nameDef] devoted herself to spreading the flower god's grace across this unfamiliar land.\n\n"If even one flower in the court is still willing to bloom, I cannot leave yet."
